obligations.title: field-wise Scope merge
obligations.evidence: auth_merge_kind, option_child_wins/option_child_presence, options_apply and append_vec are mechanized/used; append-only container/list fields merge through the verified helper; Header set uses ordered child replacement audited by the debug container snapshot; ErrorDocument and RewriteMap are list-backed with reverse child-wins lookup; parser and Options-list construction remain outside this obligation

obligations.title: Directory < Files < Location < Condition
obligations.evidence: access_plan_interleaves and the consumed plan; directory sort/pairing are outside Verus

obligations.title: per-directory Directory; access-file interleaving
obligations.evidence: verified plan and collect_layers classifier; the access walk covers every ancestor whose effective AllowOverride permits a layer and is not bounded by DocumentRoot or an alias target (access_walk_dir_admit, I47); parser-to-AccessLayer refinement is assumed

obligations.title: Require/PolicyResult semantics
obligations.evidence: PolicyResult combinators and require_none are verified; expression integer/string comparison and glob matching now run through verified kernels (expr_compare_ints, expr_compare_strs, expr_glob_match); provider/auth backends and regex/file/IP leaf semantics remain outside the model

obligations.title: RequireNone cannot grant
obligations.evidence: require_none_result proved and consumed by access.rs

obligations.title: AllowOverride/AllowOverrideList/Nonfatal gate
obligations.evidence: runtime fail-closed behavior and tests; no mechanized gate theorem

obligations.title: htaccess/cache prefilter over-approximation
obligations.evidence: prefilter_sound proves both boolean implications in Verus: htaccess_may_apply false admits no access-file layer, and a false cache prefilter over an unchanged base enable list keeps cache_enabled false; the path-pattern matcher, recursive rule flattening and parser-to-ActiveLayer refinement remain explicit assumptions

obligations.title: ACL reachability and resource binding
obligations.evidence: I1a path/URL/proxy/cache grants and I1b inode binding for file/directory; I31 binds CGI scripts by inode and FastCGI by transport/script/PATH_INFO, exports grant identity and makes the FastCGI target authoritative for derived environment; I32 binds both logical and concrete balancer identities and atomically replaces grant/resource on failover; the mechanized universal sink theorem remains open

obligations.title: Ordered competing request-to-resource mappings
obligations.evidence: first_match_is_first and first_match_none_means_no_match prove that the selected match bit is the first true one and that no bit means no match, so a later overlapping route cannot win; Alias/AliasMatch/ScriptAliasMatch and Redirect/RedirectMatch use this order, ProxyPass/ProxyPassMatch share one route_order space, handler operations use last-match wins, and unit/differential tests cover order reversal; flattening the runtime tables to the match-bit vector remains outside Verus

obligations.title: Every target-changing transform reauthorizes the sink
obligations.evidence: the I30 transform inventory covers alias mapping, CGI/FastCGI PATH_INFO and handlers, symlink targets, internal URL/filesystem rewrites, DirectoryIndex, ErrorDocument, DirectorySlash, proxy/balancer failover, cache PATH_INFO and WebSocket targets; each re-evaluates the target scope and binds the sink grant, and original-URL rechecks use the original request context plus accumulated rewrite effects; the universal Resolve/Authorize/Transform/Sink theorem remains a proof obligation

obligations.title: Scheme, peer, canonical name and identity have trusted sources
obligations.evidence: HTTPS/REQUEST_SCHEME come from listener TLS state, RemoteIP only trusts configured internal proxies, UseCanonicalName uses ServerName, and identity comes from verified authenticators; context-construction refinement is not mechanized

obligations.title: Untrusted streams have bounded size and deadlines
obligations.evidence: I33 covers request/proxy trailer count and byte budgets, proxy chunk checked_add before resize, CGI worker path/env/body/output caps, FastCGI record/header/stdout/stderr caps, HTTP/2 budgets and compression; framing-limit unit cases cover oversized chunks, long lines, trailer floods and FastCGI stderr; the aggregate resource-exhaustion model is not mechanized

obligations.title: Header set/add/unset/always semantics across all response paths
obligations.evidence: Static, directory, redirect, CGI/FastCGI, proxy and error responses apply the ordered header policy; child set replaces, unset runs last, always applies to errors; merge/application proofs are unit-tested but not mechanized

obligations.title: Every positive terminal outcome enforces original-URL and current-target grants
obligations.evidence: Static/directory, CGI/FastCGI, proxy and positive redirect outcomes require both the original request URL scope and the transformed target scope; F23 regression covers rewrite-then-proxy and rewrite-then-redirect, but the state-machine gate is not mechanized

obligations.title: Reload advances a cache generation and stale entries are never served
obligations.evidence: cache_lookup_admit binds key/policy/Vary/generation/freshness; cache_lookup_hit_requires_binding and cache_lookup_rejects_stale mechanize the consequences; disk metadata records the epoch, reload clears memory/disk and bumps the epoch, and PATH_INFO keys resolve to the actual CGI script; expiry uses verified saturating cache_expiry so positive TTLs cannot wrap into the past; admission is verified, reload orchestration is not

obligations.title: map_path, access-file walk and cache consume one alias-root identity
obligations.evidence: Relative AliasMatch/ScriptAliasMatch roots are resolved against ServerRoot at compile time and access_root_for uses the same alias table; absolute/prefix and relative/capture-only forms are unit-tested

obligations.title: Autoindex and generated headers use sink-context encoders
obligations.evidence: safe_relative_href prefixes './' before URL encoding so hostile names cannot become javascript:/data:/scheme-relative links; header values pass the verified sanitizer that now rejects every control byte except HTAB plus DEL

obligations.title: Require providers consume exactly the post-not operand
obligations.evidence: parse_require uses rest.first() for env and rest.join(' ') for expr; Require::Expr and Require::ValidUser both carry negation; unit and HTTP-level tests cover not env, not env NAME=VALUE, not expr and not valid-user

obligations.title: Every accepted .htaccess directive is modeled, explicitly inert, or rejected
obligations.evidence: htaccess SetEnv/SetEnvIf/UnsetEnv/PassEnv and IndexIgnore populate EnvironmentPolicy/ContentPolicy through the same parser as main config; RequestHeader is rejected instead of accepted as inert; DIRECTIVE_SPECS is the authoritative disposition/category registry and an exhaustive test matrix asserts every entry is effectful, inert or rejected and is gated by AllowOverride None; I34 adds the main-config fail-closed matrix for security, filter, audit and resource-limit directives plus explicit compatibility-inert warnings

obligations.title: Autoindex policy and /dir versus /dir/ authorization
obligations.evidence: IndexIgnore filters listing entries in main config and .htaccess; DirectorySlash Off reauthorizes a no-slash directory target as the canonical trailing-slash URL before index/listing dispatch

obligations.title: Regex alias targets remain inside their configured alias base
obligations.evidence: map_path returns an explicit mapping failure when a capture-only or absolute AliasMatch/ScriptAliasMatch expansion leaves fs_path; the parent-root fallback is removed; alias admission now consumes the verified component-aware path_under_base kernel (including the /srv/www versus /srv/www2 boundary), and unit plus end-to-end F31 cases cover the escape shape

obligations.title: Internal rewrite filesystem targets never change the authorization base
obligations.evidence: verified rewrite_filesystem_admit admits only files below the current document/alias root; its under_base input is produced by the verified component-aware path_under_base kernel; UnsafePrefixStat cannot re-root at the target parent; rewrite unit tests and the F32 replay cover the former server-root escape

obligations.title: FastCGI script and PATH_INFO targets are bounded by the configured base
obligations.evidence: script_from_prefix and split_path_info clean/canonicalize the script inside the FastCGI prefix or document/alias root and consume the verified component-aware path_under_base kernel; the ancestor walk cannot select an ancestor file such as /bin/sh or a sibling with a shared byte prefix such as www2; unit cases cover dot segments, $1 templates, sibling-prefix targets and outside targets

obligations.title: Cache keys bind request inputs that select authorization branches
obligations.evidence: cache_policy_material destructures Scope and hashes every policy slice (rewrite maps canonicalized); cache_policy_fingerprint frames each exact field with the verified injective cache_fingerprint_field and uses a 256-bit SHA-256 digest instead of the old 64-bit DefaultHasher; the digest also binds all request headers, peer, method and target and is stored base64 in V3 metadata. The unit matrix mutates every policy field plus listener/vhost/URL/query/target/header dimensions, and F34 replay verifies header partitioning

obligations.title: Upstream request lines and forwarded headers reject control injection
obligations.evidence: backend authorities are validated at parse time, X-Forwarded-Host is checked before insertion, and validate_proxy_head applies the verified proxy_request_line_admit and proxy_header_admit kernels (method/target/version plus token/header-value admission) immediately before every upstream write

obligations.title: Authenticated identity reaches CGI and FastCGI environment
obligations.evidence: the access-grant identity is carried into CgiContext and build_env emits REMOTE_USER/AUTH_TYPE for local CGI and FastCGI; configured environment entries remain unable to override reserved names; unit and F38 replay cases cover Basic auth

obligations.title: Single-file aliases map to parent plus basename
obligations.evidence: prefix Alias/ScriptAlias file targets are split into parent plus basename, the access-file walk uses the parent, and handler/MIME/FastCGI selection consumes the resolved basename; alias_file_target_split, alias_access_root_admit and handler_name_from_target are mechanized and the F39 replay covers .htaccess deny plus CGI source disclosure

obligations.title: Effectful directives inside <Limit> are applied or rejected
obligations.evidence: main-configuration Options/Header/AddHandler/SetHandler inside <Limit> are applied to the enclosing scope instead of warn-and-ignored, while auth/access directives remain method-scoped; .htaccess rejects non-auth directives; limit_directive_effect is mechanized and config/unit plus F40 replay cases cover Options -ExecCGI and -Indexes

obligations.title: CGI/FastCGI reauthorize and bind the actual target
obligations.evidence: the dispatcher binds the opened target before handler selection; PATH_INFO reauthorizes fd_path(file); FastCGI canonicalizes SCRIPT_FILENAME and reauthorizes the actual path before backend binding; cgi_actual_target_admit is mechanized and the F41 replay covers direct, PATH_INFO and FastCGI symlink targets

obligations.title: Capture-only regex aliases have no implicit ServerRoot base
obligations.evidence: Alias::regex keeps an empty base for leading-capture replacements and map_path fails closed for every empty-base mapping; capture_only_alias_admit is mechanized and the F42 replay asserts .htpasswd, rewrite secrets and the configuration are not readable

obligations.title: Spool/temp files use exclusive creation and private mode
obligations.evidence: the FastCGI spool uses create_new, mode 0600, bounded collision retries and immediate unlink; temp_file_create_admit is mechanized and unit cases plant a symlink at the predicted name and verify the target is untouched and the descriptor is private

obligations.title: Disk cache has a total quota, entry cap and expiry cleanup
obligations.evidence: cache_disk_projected and cache_disk_evict mechanize replacement projection and monotone eviction; persisted bytes are tracked per cache root, CacheMaxDiskSize and MAX_DISK_ENTRIES are enforced by evicting the oldest stems, oversized entries are refused, expired/old-generation files are deleted on load, per-key variants are capped, and CacheIgnoreQueryString bypasses dynamic CGI/FastCGI/proxy targets

obligations.title: Expression file tests use the document-root confinement
obligations.evidence: Expr::FileTest consumes confined_expr_path for -f/-d/-e/-s/-F/-U, rejecting absolute, parent-relative and escaping-symlink arguments; main-config <IfFile> uses a separate operator-supplied Expr::IfFile; expr_file_test_admit is mechanized and unit cases cover absolute paths and an escaping symlink; rewrite condition -f/-d/-s/-l tests now also canonicalize the probed path and consume path_under_base so an in-root symlink cannot probe outside the document/alias root

obligations.title: RequireNone fails when any child provider is satisfied
obligations.evidence: combine_or_all and require_none_multi aggregate every child as an OR of positive hits before negation, so a granted child cannot be neutralized by a denied sibling; access.rs consumes require_none_multi and require_none_multi_result is the mechanized disposition predicate; main-config, .htaccess, unit and generated Apache differential cases cover two-provider and three-provider block lists

obligations.title: Regex alias file targets use parent plus basename and the parent access root
obligations.evidence: map_path splits a regex alias target that resolves to a regular file into parent plus basename with or without a trailing slash in the replacement; the URL/base root uses the file parent via alias_access_root_admit for regex and prefix aliases alike, while ancestor authorization follows I47 independently of that root; unit plus F47 replays cover AliasMatch/ScriptAliasMatch static and CGI targets

obligations.title: Virtual-host selection is bound to destination address and port
obligations.evidence: Config::select_vhost consumes vhost_address_admit and vhost_address_precedence with the destination address; address-bound vhosts are ineligible on another address and exact-address vhosts precede wildcard vhosts; HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, WebSocket, cache and logging pass the local address, TLS filters vhosts when the listener has a concrete address, and unit plus F48 replays cover both loopback addresses

obligations.title: Authorization consumes a canonical IPv4/IPv6 peer identity
obligations.evidence: ipv4_mapped_to_v4 is the verified conversion consumed by access::canonical_ip; the accept boundary and RemoteIP path canonicalize before request context construction, and ip_in_net, Require local, logs, cache and CGI identities use the canonical peer; unit plus dual-stack F49 replays cover mapped deny, allow and local cases

obligations.title: Access-file walk covers every applicable ancestor
obligations.evidence: access_walk_dir_admit states that each ancestor participates when its effective AllowOverride policy permits a layer; collect_layers/apply_req_deferred walk filesystem ancestors without a DocumentRoot or alias-root lower bound, and access_file_layer_read no longer contains an under_root conjunct; unit plus F50 replays cover DocumentRoot parent Basic auth/deny, directory index, CGI, cache lookup and alias-target parents

obligations.title: Mapping root comes from URL-selected alias
obligations.evidence: alias_mapping_root_admit states that a root inferred from alias-target containment is never admitted; map_path returns the URL-selected root and dispatch, cache, rewrite reauthorization and --explain pass it to the access walk for RewriteBase/URL-base derivation only; unit plus F51 replays cover overlapping prefix/regex Alias, ScriptAlias and both alias orders

obligations.title: DirectoryIndex cache key and policy bind the selected target
obligations.evidence: cache_directory_index_bind_admit requires an index-selected directory cache entry to bind both key and policy to the index; cache_ignore_query_admit forbids merging dynamic index/script representations across queries; request_scope resolves DirectoryIndex, re-evaluates the index scope and binds the opened index target before lookup/store; unit plus F52 replays cover cross-query CGI indexes and live <Files> denies for directory and direct index URLs

obligations.title: Canonical REQUEST_URI for expressions, rewrites and environment rules
obligations.evidence: request_uri_identity_admit requires REQUEST_URI to be bound to the dispatcher's canonical URL path, query-free and never the raw request-line target. RequestPlan supplies that target to dispatch, cache and --explain; expr::Context::new, Scope::request_env, access::check, rewrite::Context::for_plan and CGI build_env consume the canonical URL path. Require expr/<If>, SetEnvIf Request_URI, RewriteCond and substitution expansion no longer read req.target or append the query string. Unit plus F57 raw-socket replays cover query suffixes, percent-encoded names, dot segments, allow-list and deny-list shapes

obligations.title: One immutable request plan for dispatch, cache, rewrite and explain
obligations.evidence: RequestPlan is built once per request or rewrite round from CanonicalTarget and map_path, collects the access-file layers once, and exposes canonical URL path, mapping root, relative/fs paths, script-alias state and layers. dispatch_inner_request passes the same plan to cache lookup/store and dispatch; cache no longer re-decodes raw_path or rebuilds mapping; rewrite::Context::for_plan consumes plan identity; --explain prints the plan's canonical path, mapping, layer directories, URL mounts and subjects. Integration coverage exercises cache hits, rewrite rounds, CGI PATH_INFO, DirectoryIndex and explain; the universal refinement theorem remains open

obligations.title: Per-directory rewrite URL base, filesystem subject and plan identity
obligations.evidence: request_plan::layer_url_mount is the single URL-mount derivation for access files and main-config <Directory> rewrites; request_plan::layer_subject is the single filesystem-relative RewriteRule subject derivation used by rewrite::subject_for. Every parsed access-file rule carries its layer directory, and htaccess_rewrite_subject_admit requires a derivable subject or fails closed instead of silently skipping a layer. RequestPlan now carries the canonical target, mapping root, relative path, filesystem target and collected access layers for dispatch, cache, rewrite contexts and --explain (I59). Unit plus F53/F58 replays cover prefix Alias, AliasMatch, ScriptAlias, nested .htaccess, explicit RewriteBase, document-root/ancestor layers above the mapping root, and [F]/[G]/[E]/[R] effects

obligations.title: Every non-default handler is dynamic for cache-query isolation
obligations.evidence: cache_dynamic_handler_admit states that a dynamic handler requires a cache bypass; request_scope classifies the effective handler after DirectoryIndex resolution, covering SetHandler proxy:fcgi (direct and index), cgi-script, server-status and future non-default handlers in addition to ProxyPass routes. Unit plus F54 fastcgi-mock replays cover direct and index queries

obligations.title: Cache key material is injective over raw bytes
obligations.evidence: cache_key_hex is refined to cache_key_hex_spec and proved length-preserving and injective (cache_key_hex_spec_injective, hex_byte_spec_injective); base_key hex-encodes server root, host, path, raw query and resolved target bytes, non-UTF-8 URL paths bypass the shared cache, invalid index names are rejected, and invalidation uses the same encoding. Unit plus F55 raw-socket replays cover invalid query bytes versus empty and replacement-byte queries

obligations.title: Local ErrorDocument subrequests are excluded from the original URL cache
obligations.evidence: cache_local_error_document_admit excludes a missing target that can select a local ErrorDocument from lookup/store and refuses to store any response produced by an ErrorDocument internal subrequest (response-provenance marker); existing targets retain normal cache behavior. Unit plus F56 fastcgi-mock replays cover query-dependent local error documents without regressing the Apache cache conformance cases

obligations.title: Only bodyless credential-free GETs with safe response shape enter the cache
obligations.evidence: cache_store_request_admit, cache_store_status_admit, cache_store_control_admit, cache_store_shape_admit and cache_store_ttl_admit mechanize the runtime store gates for method/body/credentials, cacheable statuses, Cache-Control overrides, Set-Cookie/Vary:*/size and positive freshness; cache_ttl_clamp returns zero for reversed CacheMinExpire/CacheMaxExpire instead of panicking. Unit matrix plus conformance cache cases exercise each branch
